items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
SCENE: PEAK, first-person co-op climbing/survival. Menu -> PLAY OFFLINE -> terminal prologue (BINGBONG Airways; passport; GATE KIOSK on stanchion post with blue screen, pitch down to get prompt) -> START -> globe/flight loading. This run the globe arc sat ~complete for 2.5+ min; clicks/Space/Return did nothing; Escape produced a black frame, then the beach scene appeared (uncertain whether Escape caused it).

CONTROLS (observed): WASD move; Shift sprint; Space jump/mantle; Left/Right/Up/Down arrows turn/pitch (short taps 0.1-0.6s); mouse drag does NOT turn view; E interact (long ~1.0-1.5s holds work); J item action (shoot/heal/use); Q drop/throw; 1/2/3/4 hotbar, pressing same slot again stows; Control crouch — crouch+W passed under a chest-high vine; Escape pause.

MECHANICS: Prompts only when crosshair dot is on the target and you're close ('NAME E verb'). Crosshair dot white = not climbable, yellow/orange = climbable/grab. Bare-hand climb = hold W+J; a W+Space jump can reposition the crosshair onto a yellow rim, then W+J climbs (this worked on the sand dome; failed on flat faces with no stamina drain). Sand slopes walkable if not too steep; steep dark rock/sand faces are not. Sprint fills then drains the blue stamina bar. Falling can down the player (E give up). Moonlight/night occurs; sunsets.

BEACH SPAWN (SHORE - DAY ONE): big white 'BIG LUGGAGE' opens with ~1.5s E; contents: ROPE CANNON (slot1, 'shoot J'), BANDAGES (slot2, 'heal J'), BALLOON BUNCH (slot3, 'use J', blocks view when held), plus rolling pin/scenery. Smaller suitcases, crab and toy-dog plush are scenery (no prompts). Blue tarp/brochure, campfire flame, palm planters present.

ROUTE SO FAR: left around open suitcase -> grass dunes -> palm forest -> white crystalline spire cluster (a dark sand pit hazard right of them; skirted left) -> pink ruin pillars/walls -> repeated dead-end pinches between slabs and steep sand domes (white block corner, flat pillar faces) -> jumped then W+J climbed the big sand dome onto a driftwood/shrub ledge -> low logs (W+Space mantle) -> mushroom cave path in dark rock walls -> found 'WARP FUNGUS — E pick up' (blue ring object on dark rock) -> now in a red hoodoo gully with pink crystal plants, ferns, tan smooth slope left, white slab wall right, dark boulder stack center. A blue beam/light column has been visible repeatedly above/beyond the boulder rim (top-center-right) and is the steering landmark.

FAILED STRATEGIES: mistaking white recycle bins / blue wall monitors for the kiosk; circling the annex back wall; jumping stanchion ropes; clicking/waiting inputs during globe loading; mouse-drag turning; W+J on flat rock faces (no grip); walking up steep sand/rock banks; climbing the dark boulder stack from the hoodoo floor; ROPE CANNON J taps/longs produced no visible rope and the cannon then vanished from slot 1; pressing 4 repeatedly with warp fungus did not visibly equip it and slot 4 later emptied (warp fungus state lost/unknown). Known dead ends: white block corner, slab/slope pinches, tight crack beside tan trunk in the hoodoo gully.

ACTIVE GOAL: escape the hoodoo gully toward the blue beam, then continue to the peak (PEAKS SUMMITTED still 0; summit never reached).

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES (guesses): blue beam marks an objective/checkpoint; warp fungus was a teleport but its use and current possession are unknown; balloon bunch may slow falls; hunger/food effects untested; 'bugle for a capybara' badge not earned; BING BONG creature re-obtainability after item loss unknown; cave chimney near beach cliffs may be a climb route.

UNCERTAINTY: exact arrow-turn magnitudes approximate; whether terrain right of the central hoodoo boulder or the slanted slab facet is passable is unverified (last 2s W+D there gave no visible change).
